g.text: Reaching the SelfPrivacy backend (device B) over HTTPS — routes & where the name comes from
SelfPrivacy serves 5 vhosts on :443, routed by Host header, so
each service needs a public name:
(one wildcard *.<domain>, or 5 DNS records / 5 tunnel public-hostnames).
(when you must bring your OWN name)
— delegable NS → the ONLY free source that works with a
A safe · B reliable across reboot/IP-change · C free · D decentralised · E human-readable name
E · no relay, no port-forward · ONLY if the ISP gives a public IPv6
— A B C · (E only with your OWN domain; free-host = random name) · behind-CGNAT, but NOT D; CF ToS caps video
— A B C D E · needs router admin + a real public IPv4 (dead under CGNAT)
— A B C D · always works, no infra · but not E (56-char) and Tor-only
